result.summary: The page is generally well structured, but horizontal content is visibly clipped at the right edge and one restaurant card has a broken/missing image placeholder.

issues.description: The horizontal category row is cut off at the right edge: an unlabeled partial chip is visible after “Healthy.” The “Fastest near you” restaurant carousel also cuts off the third card, including its restaurant name (“Trattoria Piccol…”), creating an abrupt, unfinished appearance.
issues.suggestion: Implement a clearly intentional horizontally scrollable carousel with consistent side padding and/or a partial next-card affordance that does not truncate key text. Ensure cards and category chips do not render as ambiguous clipped fragments.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card’s hero image is missing and displays a generic broken-image placeholder icon in a large gray image area.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image asset/source and provide a designed fallback image or restaurant-specific placeholder if the image cannot load.

issues.description: The next popular restaurant card is partially obscured by the fixed bottom navigation, leaving only the top of its image visible at the bottom of the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom content padding or adjust the fixed navigation overlap so scrolling content can remain fully visible above the navigation bar.
